note: Service: State Defence Service (NDS), as the Ministry of Defence's FAQ states it: male citizens born after 1 January 2004 can be drafted within 12 months of reaching 18 if not in education, within 12 months after finishing general, secondary or vocational education, or within 12 months of reaching 24 if their studies aren't done by then; so the call runs from 18 until 25 (a reading of those windows; the State Defence Service Law itself wasn't reached). The ordinary term is 11 months in the regular forces or the National Guard (the alternatives, five years in the National Guard or a reserve-officer programme for students, aren't held). Men and women of 18 up to 27 may volunteer. Majority and work: not read. The Civil Law (Article 219) and the Labour Law (Section 37, on employing children and the State Labour Inspectorate's permit for children under 13 in culture, art, sport and advertising) are published on likumi.lv, which reset every connection today, as did the State Labour Inspectorate (vdi.gov.lv), the Ministry of Welfare and the State Language Centre's translations; archive.org couldn't be reached either. Neither is held.

sources.title: Ministry of Defence of Latvia, Frequently asked questions about State Defence Service
sources.said: Male citizens of Latvia born after 1 January 2004 can be drafted into NDS: within 12 months of reaching age 18 if they are not in education ... within 12 months of reaching the age 24 if they have failed to complete their studies by the age of 24 ... Male and female Latvian citizens aged 18 up until reaching 27 can volunteer for National Defence Service. ... 11 months in regular forces of the National Armed Forces or National Guard
